xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe: The above unaudited financial results for the quarter and six months ended 30th September, 2026 were reviewed by the Audit Committee and thereafter approved by the Board of Directors at the meeting held on 5th November, 2026. The Statutory Auditors have carried out a limited review of the above financial results. 2.The above financial results have been prepared in accordance with Indian Accounting Standard ('Ind AS') referred to in the Companies (Indian Accounting Standard) Rules, 2015 prescribed under Section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013. 3. Sugar being seasonal industry, the performance of the Company varies from quarter to quarter and the results for the quarter as such may not be representative of the annual performance of the Company. 4. In terms of Ind AS 108 "Operating Segments", the company does not have operating segments for the period as it is engaged mainly in manufacturing of sugar. 5. The Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal, Allahabad Bench, Prayagraj (“NCLT”), vide its order dated August 19, 2026, has approved the Scheme of Arrangement (“Scheme”) between K M Sugar Mills Limited (Demerged Company) and K M Spirits and Allied Industries Limited (‘Resulting Company’) and their respective shareholders and creditors for the demerger of the Distillery Division. The Scheme became effective on October 01, 2026.(i) Distillery Division of K M Sugar Mills Limited has been demerged and vested in KM Spirits and Allied Industries Limited as a going concern w.e.f. the demerger appointed date of April 1, 2026. (ii) Investment in the Resulting Company amounting to Rs.5.00 lakhs has been adjusted from the reserves, and all the carrying value of assets and liabilities of the distillery division have been transferred to the Resulting Company. The difference between the value of transferred assets and liabilities pertaining to the distillery division has been adjusted from the other equity.(iii) Pursuant to the Scheme, KM Spirits and Allied Industries Limited has allotted 1,84,00,034 fully paid Equity Shares of 10/- each to the shareholders of the Demerged Company on the record date, i.e., October 02, 2026 and therefore it has ceased to be a subsidiary of the Company. Accordingly, the Company is no longer required to prepare the consolidated financial results for the quarter ended on September 30, 2026.(iv) Accordingly, the financial results of the Company for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 and the quarter and the six months ended September 30, 2026, do not include the financial performance of the Distillery Division of the Company. Moreover, the financial results of the Company for the quarter and six months ended on September 30, 2025 and year ended on March 31, 2026, have been restated to exclude the financial performance of the Distillery Division of the Company.(v) Brief particulars of the discontinued operations for the periods as detailed in odf. 6.Previous period figures have been regrouped /rearranged, wherever considered necessary, to make them comparable with the current period.
